roman: geuraeseo godae gyohoeui "roma" jugyoneun gidokgyoga igyododeureul jeongbokhaetdaneun uimieseo igyoui chukjeirin dongjireul "geuriseudoui tansaengil"ro chaetaekhaetseupnida
translation_en: So the Bishop of Rome of the ancient church adopted the pagan festival of the winter solstice as "The Birth of Christ" in the sense that Christianity conquered the pagans.

kor_sent: 본래 로마에서는 하루 해가 가장 짧았다가 길어지기 시작하는 12월 25일을 "태양의 탄생일"로 보고 이날을 축제일로 삼아 농업을 주관하는 Saturnalia라고 불리는 신에게 제사를 지냈습니다
roman: bonrae romaeseoneun haru haega gajang jjalbatdaga gireojigi sijakhaneun 12wol 25ireul "taeyangui tansaengil"ro bogo inareul chukjeilro sama nongeobeul jugwanhaneun Saturnaliarago bulrineun sinege jesareul jinaetseupnida
translation_en: Originally, in Rome, the sun was the shortest day, and it started to grow on December 25th as "The Birth of the Sun," and it was dedicated to a god called Satrealia, who is the head of agriculture for this day.

kor_sent: 이것은 주후 274년 Aurelian 로마황제에 의하여 되어진 일입니다
roman: igeoseun juhu 274nyeon Aurelian romahwangjee uihayeo doeeojin iripnida
translation_en: This was done in 274, by the Roman emperor Aurelian.

kor_sent: 북구라파에서는 이전부터 "태양이 다시 소생"하는 동지 (冬至)를 크게 기념하는 축제(Festival)를 전통적으로 지켜 왔었습니다
roman: bukgurapaeseoneun ijeonbuteo "taeyangi dasi sosaeng"haneun dongji (冬至)reul keuge ginyeomhaneun chukje(Festival)reul jeontongjeogeuro jikyeo wasseotseupnida
translation_en: In northern Europe, we've traditionally celebrated the Festival of Festivals in which the sun is revived.

kor_sent: 기독교에서는 그리스도를 "세상의 빛"(요 1:9)이라고 합니다
roman: gidokgyoeseoneun geuriseudoreul "sesangui bit"(yo 1:9)irago hapnida
translation_en: In Christianity, Christ is called "the light of the world."

kor_sent: 그리스도의 탄생은 "빛"의 탄생입니다
roman: geuriseudoui tansaengeun "bit"ui tansaengipnida
translation_en: The birth of Christ is the birth of light.

kor_sent: 로마에서 이교도들이 12월 25일을 "태양의 탄생일"로 정한 것과 기독교에서 "세상의 빛"이 탄생한 날을 12월 25일로 결정한 것은 이교도들의 "태양의 빛"을 기독교의 "세상의 빛"으로 일치시킴으로 기독교를 이교도들에게 더욱 의미 있게 설명할 수 있도록 하기 위해서인 것 같습니다
roman: romaeseo igyododeuri 12wol 25ireul "taeyangui tansaengil"ro jeonghan geotgwa gidokgyoeseo "sesangui bit"i tansaenghan nareul 12wol 25ilro gyeoljeonghan geoseun igyododeurui "taeyangui bit"eul gidokgyoui "sesangui bit"euro ilchisikimeuro gidokgyoreul igyododeurege deouk uimi itge seolmyeonghal su itdorok hagi wihaeseoin geot gatseupnida
translation_en: The fact that the pagans in Rome have defined December 25 as "the birth of the sun" and the day of the birth of "the light of the world" in Christianity as "the light of the sun" in order to make Christianity more meaningful to the heathen.

kor_sent: 어떤 사람들은 12월 25일의 성탄절이 이렇게 이교도의 절일을 성탄절로 했기 때문에 잘못되었다고 비난합니다
roman: eotteon saramdeureun 12wol 25irui seongtanjeori ireoke igyodoui jeorireul seongtanjeolro haetgi ttaemune jalmotdoeeotdago binanhapnida
translation_en: Some people accuse December 25th of being wrong because it was this pagan feast.

kor_sent: 그런데 교회당이 절간으로 되었으면 기독교인의 입장에서 잘못되었지만 절간이 교회당이 되었다면 그것 잘 된 것 아닙니까? 다시 누가복음 2장으로 돌아가겠습니다
roman: geureonde gyohoedangi jeolganeuro doeeosseumyeon gidokgyoinui ipjangeseo jalmotdoeeotjiman jeolgani gyohoedangi doeeotdamyeon geugeot jal doen geot anipnikka? dasi nugabogeum 2jangeuro doragagetseupnida
translation_en: But if the church was a temple, it would be a Christian's fault, but if it became a church, wouldn't that be a good thing?

kor_sent: 어느 날 베들레헴 마을 주변 들판에서 목자들이 밤에 양떼를 지키고 있는데 갑자기 하늘이 환해지면서 한 천사가 나타나서 온 백성에게 미칠 큰 기쁨의 좋은 소식을 전할 것이라 했습니다
roman: eoneu nal bedeulrehem maeul jubyeon deulpaneseo mokjadeuri bame yangttereul jikigo itneunde gapjagi haneuri hwanhaejimyeonseo han cheonsaga natanaseo on baekseongege michil keun gippeumui joeun sosigeul jeonhal geosira haetseupnida
translation_en: One day shepherds were watching over the flocks by night in the fields around the village of Bethlehem, and suddenly the sky was bright, and an angel would appear and give good news of great joy to all the people.

kor_sent: 오늘날 다윗의 동네에 너희를위하여 구주가 나셨으니 곧 그리스도 주시니라
roman: oneulnal dawisui dongnee neohuireurwihayeo gujuga nasyeosseuni got geuriseudo jusinira
translation_en: For there is born to you this day a Savior in the city of David, Christ;

kor_sent: 너희가 가서 강보에 싸여 구유에 누인 아기를 보리니 이것이 너희에게 표적이니라 하더니 천군천사가 나타나 하나님을 찬송하니, 지극히 높은 곳에서는 하나님께 영광이요 땅에서는 기뻐하심을 입은 사람들 중에는 평화로다 했습니다
roman: neohuiga gaseo gangboe ssayeo guyue nuin agireul borini igeosi neohuiege pyojeoginira hadeoni cheonguncheonsaga natana hananimeul chansonghani, jigeukhi nopeun goseseoneun hananimkke yeonggwangiyo ttangeseoneun gippeohasimeul ibeun saramdeul jungeneun pyeonghwaroda haetseupnida
translation_en: "Go and see the child wrapped in cloths, lying in a manger, and behold, it is a sign to you." But an angel of heaven appeared, and blessed God, and was glorified by God in the highest places, and on earth were all those who rejoiced in him. "Peace be with you."

kor_sent: 지구 상의 인간들에게 천상의 천군천사들이 이렇게 많이 보여 준 것은 처음있는 일입니다
roman: jigu sangui ingandeurege cheonsangui cheonguncheonsadeuri ireoke mani boyeo jun geoseun cheoeumitneun iripnida
translation_en: It's the first time that heavenly angels in heaven have shown so much to humans on earth.

kor_sent: 그런데 이런 일이 한 번 더 있을 것입니다
roman: geureonde ireon iri han beon deo isseul geosipnida
translation_en: But it's going to happen one more time.

kor_sent: 그 때는 예수님의 재림 때 일 것입니다
roman: geu ttaeneun yesunimui jaerim ttae il geosipnida
translation_en: It will be the second coming of Jesus.

kor_sent: 예수님의 초림과 재림 시에 이렇게 천사들의 활동이 빈번해 집니다
roman: yesunimui chorimgwa jaerim sie ireoke cheonsadeurui hwaldongi binbeonhae jipnida
translation_en: In the first and second days of Jesus Christ, there is so much activity in the angels.

kor_sent: 이 목자들은 그 당시 세상에서 소외된 사람들입니다
roman: i mokjadeureun geu dangsi sesangeseo sooedoen saramdeuripnida
translation_en: These shepherds are the outcasts of the world at that time.

kor_sent: 다른 사람들은 밤에 잠잘 때에 이들은 잠도 잘 수 없이 남의 양떼를 지키고 있습니다
roman: dareun saramdeureun bame jamjal ttaee ideureun jamdo jal su eopsi namui yangttereul jikigo itseupnida
translation_en: When others sleep at night, they can't sleep. They're keeping watch over other people's flocks.

kor_sent: 이때에 천사들이 나타나서 온 백성들에게 전할 큰 기쁨의 좋은 소식을 전달받았습니다
roman: ittaee cheonsadeuri natanaseo on baekseongdeurege jeonhal keun gippeumui joeun sosigeul jeondalbadatseupnida
translation_en: Then the angels appeared, and they received good news of great joy for the whole world.

kor_sent: 이 시간에 이 큰 기쁨의 좋은 소식을 받을 사람들은 밤을 지키는 이 목자들 밖에 없었습니다
roman: i sigane i keun gippeumui joeun sosigeul badeul saramdeureun bameul jikineun i mokjadeul bakke eopseotseupnida
translation_en: The only people who would receive the good news of this great joy at this hour were these shepherds who kept the night.

kor_sent: 하나님의 아들이시요 온 인류의 구주로 오신 그리스도 주님이 오심을 가장 미천하고 소외된 목자들에게 전달되었습니다
roman: hananimui adeurisiyo on inryuui gujuro osin geuriseudo junimi osimeul gajang micheonhago sooedoen mokjadeurege jeondaldoeeotseupnida
translation_en: The Son of God, the Savior of all mankind, to the humblest and most alienated shepherds, who have come.

kor_sent: 그런데 이 천사들이 전하여 준 소식을 확증하는 방법을 제시했는데 그것은 강보에 싸여 구유에 눕힌 아기가 바로 그리스도 주라고 합니다
roman: geureonde i cheonsadeuri jeonhayeo jun sosigeul hwakjeunghaneun bangbeobeul jesihaetneunde geugeoseun gangboe ssayeo guyue nuphin agiga baro geuriseudo jurago hapnida
translation_en: But they presented a way to confirm the good news that these angels brought to them, saying that the Lord of Christ is the child wrapped in cloths and laid in a manger.

kor_sent: 만약 아기가 여관이나 집에서 태어났다면 목자들이 그 아기에게 접근하기가 어려웠을 것입니다
roman: manyak agiga yeogwanina jibeseo taeeonatdamyeon mokjadeuri geu agiege jeopgeunhagiga eoryeowosseul geosipnida
translation_en: If the baby was born in the inn or at home, it would have been hard for the shepherds to approach it.

kor_sent: 이들은 베들레헴 사람들입니다
roman: ideureun bedeulrehem saramdeuripnida
translation_en: These are the Bethlehemites.

kor_sent: 작은 마을 모든 사람들은 서로를 잘 알고 있습니다
roman: jageun maeul modeun saramdeureun seororeul jal algo itseupnida
translation_en: Everyone in the small village knows each other well.

kor_sent: 어느 집에 외양간이 있다는 것과 그 외양간을 찾는 것이 어렵지 않았고 또 외양간이니까 문을 두드릴 필요도 없이 그 외양간에 들어가 아기를 볼 수 있었을 것입니다
roman: eoneu jibe oeyanggani itdaneun geotgwa geu oeyangganeul chatneun geosi eoryeopji anatgo tto oeyangganinikka muneul dudeuril piryodo eopsi geu oeyanggane deureoga agireul bol su isseosseul geosipnida
translation_en: It wasn't hard to find a barn in a house, it was not hard to find a barn, so you could go in there and see a baby without having to knock on the door.

kor_sent: 그들이 외양간의 구유에 눕힌 아기를 찾는 것은 쉬운 일입니다
roman: geudeuri oeyangganui guyue nuphin agireul chatneun geoseun swiun iripnida
translation_en: It's easy for them to find a baby lying in a manger.

kor_sent: 그리고 이들이 자기들에게 일어난 일을 상세히 말할 때에 이 말을 듣고 사람들이 기이히 여겼다고 합니다
roman: geurigo ideuri jagideurege ireonan ireul sangsehi malhal ttaee i mareul deutgo saramdeuri giihi yeogyeotdago hapnida
translation_en: And when they told the details of what happened to them, they were surprised to hear this.

kor_sent: 그리고 마리아는 이 말을 듣고 누가복음 2:19에서 ‘이 모든 말을 마음에 새기어 생각하니라’ 했는데 무슨 생각을 했겠습니까? 마리아는 하나님의 아들이 탄생할 것이라 가브리엘 천사가 말했는데 그렇다면 아기가 탄생할 때에 하나님께서 따뜻하고 아늑한 자리에서 아기를 출산하도록 해 주셔야 할 텐데 마구간에서 태어나 여물통에 눕힌 아기를 보면서 이 아이가 정말 하나님의 아들 맞나, 내가 천사의 수태고지를 받은 것이 정말인가 의심하고 있었을 텐데 마침 그 때에 목자들이 전하는 말을 듣고 위로와 확신을 받았으리라 생각합니다
roman: geurigo marianeun i mareul deutgo nugabogeum 2:19eseo ‘i modeun mareul maeume saegieo saenggakhanira’ haetneunde museun saenggageul haetgetseupnikka? marianeun hananimui adeuri tansaenghal geosira gabeuriel cheonsaga malhaetneunde geureotamyeon agiga tansaenghal ttaee hananimkkeseo ttatteuthago aneukhan jarieseo agireul chulsanhadorok hae jusyeoya hal tende maguganeseo taeeona yeomultonge nuphin agireul bomyeonseo i aiga jeongmal hananimui adeul matna, naega cheonsaui sutaegojireul badeun geosi jeongmaringa uisimhago isseosseul tende machim geu ttaee mokjadeuri jeonhaneun mareul deutgo wirowa hwaksineul badasseurira saenggakhapnida
translation_en: And what did Mary think when she heard this, when she said at Luke 2: 19, that the Son of God would be born, and that, when the angel Gabriel said, "God must have given birth to a child in a warm, cozy place, in a stable, lying in a water well, and she would have seen the child, and she would have wondered whether it was really the Son of God, or whether I had been conceived by an angel, and they would have been convinced at the time of their hearing the shepherds and of their comfort?"

kor_sent: 그리고는 누가복음 2:21로 나아갑니다
roman: geurigoneun nugabogeum 2:21ro naagapnida
translation_en: And then we go to Luke 2:21.

kor_sent: 21절에서 아기가 난지 팔 일이 되어 할례를 받는 장면이 나옵니다
roman: 21jeoreseo agiga nanji pal iri doeeo halryereul batneun jangmyeoni naopnida
translation_en: In verse 21, the baby was born, eight days, and he was circumcised.

kor_sent: 유대관습에 새 아기가 태어날 때에 여자 아이는 나자마자 이름을 받습니다
roman: yudaegwanseube sae agiga taeeonal ttaee yeoja aineun najamaja ireumeul batseupnida
translation_en: And when the new child is born in the Jewish custom, the female child is given a name as soon as she is born.

kor_sent: 그러나 남자 아이는 할례를 받는 날에 이름을 받습니다
roman: geureona namja aineun halryereul batneun nare ireumeul batseupnida
translation_en: But the boy gets his name on the day of his circumcision.

kor_sent: 할례는 집에서 아버지 요셉이 실시했습니다
roman: halryeneun jibeseo abeoji yosebi silsihaetseupnida
translation_en: Circumcision was performed at home by my father, Joseph.

kor_sent: 그리고 누가복음 2:22로 나아가는데, 22절은 모세의 법대로 ‘결례’의 날이 차매 아기를 데리고 예루살렘으로 올라 갔다고 합니다
roman: geurigo nugabogeum 2:22ro naaganeunde, 22jeoreun moseui beopdaero ‘gyeolrye’ui nari chamae agireul derigo yerusalremeuro olra gatdago hapnida
translation_en: And then we go to Luke 2:22, which says, according to the Mosaic law, that when the day of purification ended, we took the baby up to Jerusalem.

kor_sent: 여기 ‘결례’의 날의 결례는 산모가 행하는 결례입니다
roman: yeogi ‘gyeolrye’ui narui gyeolryeneun sanmoga haenghaneun gyeolryeipnida
translation_en: Here's what a mother does on the Day of purification.

kor_sent: 레위기 12:1-8말씀에 아이를 낳은 산모들은 부정하게 되는데 부정을 씻어내는 정결의식을 행하는 날을 말합니다
roman: rewigi 12:1-8malsseume aireul naeun sanmodeureun bujeonghage doeneunde bujeongeul ssiseonaeneun jeonggyeoruisigeul haenghaneun nareul malhapnida
translation_en: The mothers who gave birth to children at Leviticus 12: 1 - 8 are unclean, the days of ritual cleansing.

kor_sent: 남자아이를 낳은 산모는 40일 만에 정결예식을 행하고 여자아이를 낳은 산모는 80일이라 했습니다
roman: namjaaireul naeun sanmoneun 40il mane jeonggyeoryesigeul haenghago yeojaaireul naeun sanmoneun 80irira haetseupnida
translation_en: The mother who gave birth to a boy, after 40 days of ritual cleansing, and the mother who gave birth to a girl, said 80 days.

kor_sent: 누가복음 2:22을 보면 요셉과 마리아가 40일이 되었는데도 자신들이 살던 나사렛으로 돌아가지 않고 계속 베들레헴에 머물러 있다가 결례를 행하려 예루살렘으로 갑니다
roman: nugabogeum 2:22eul bomyeon yosepgwa mariaga 40iri doeeotneundedo jasindeuri saldeon nasareseuro doragaji anko gyesok bedeulreheme meomulreo itdaga gyeolryereul haengharyeo yerusalremeuro gapnida
translation_en: Luke 2: 22 tells us that Joseph and Mary, after 40 days, did not return to Nazareth where they lived, but remained in Bethlehem and went to Jerusalem for purification.

kor_sent: 그리고 23절에서 마리아가 정결예식을 위하여 예루살렘에 가면서 아기를 데리고 갔다고 했습니다
roman: geurigo 23jeoreseo mariaga jeonggyeoryesigeul wihayeo yerusalreme gamyeonseo agireul derigo gatdago haetseupnida
translation_en: And in Mt 24 verse 23, she went to Jerusalem for a cleansing ceremony and took the baby with her.

roman: 23jeol, 24jeore, ’23 ineun juui yulbeobe sseun ba cheot taee cheoeum nan namjamada juui georukhan jara harira han daero agireul jukke deurigo 24 tto juui yulbeobe malsseumhasin daero sanbidulgi han ssangina hogeun eorin jipbidulgi dulro jesaharyeo hamideora
translation_en: In the 23rd and 24th verses, and twenty-three, as it is written in the law of the Lord, every firstborn male in his first womb shall be holy to the Lord, to offer the child, and to sacrifice to the Lord twenty-four, as it is spoken in the law of the Lord, a pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

kor_sent: ’했습니다
roman: ’haetseupnida
translation_en: I'm going to do it. ’

kor_sent: 이것은 출애굽기 13:12에서 유례한 것인데 출애굽할 때에 애굽 사람들의 첫 아들들이 다 죽을 때에 이스라엘 장자들은 구원받은 것을 기념하기 위해서 입니다
